_note: 英語島文法分區（最後一批）：非限定被動（eng.t_sub.voice.nonfinite，學測級）。被動不定詞 to be + p.p.（The room needs to be cleaned）；need/want + V-ing 帶被動義（The car needs washing = needs to be washed）；使役 have something done（I had my hair cut）；被動動名詞 being + p.p.（He hates being told）。形式依 Cambridge/Oxford/Swan，provisional，待英語母語 reviewer 複核。text-only shadowing、無音檔。

units.title_zh: 被動不定詞與動名詞（to be done / being done）
units.can_do: 我能用非限定的被動形式：被動不定詞 to be + 過去分詞（The work needs to be done）、使役 have something done（I had my hair cut）、被動動名詞 being + 過去分詞（He hates being told），以及 need/want + V-ing 帶被動意思（The car needs washing）。
units.subject: eng

claims.text: The passive infinitive is 'to be + past participle'. We use it when the subject receives the action: 'The room needs to be cleaned.' 'This form has to be filled in.'
claims.verification_ref: 被動不定詞＝to be + 過去分詞（The room needs to be cleaned）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: After 'need' (and informally 'want'), a gerund '-ing' can carry a passive meaning: 'The car needs washing' = 'The car needs to be washed.'
claims.verification_ref: need/want + V-ing 帶被動義：The car needs washing＝needs to be washed；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: The causative 'have/get something done' means we arrange for someone else to do it: 'I had my hair cut.' 'We are getting the house painted.' The pattern is 'have + object + past participle'.
claims.verification_ref: 使役被動 have something done＝安排別人做（I had my hair cut）；have + 受詞 + 過去分詞；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: The passive gerund is 'being + past participle'. It works as a noun: 'Nobody likes being laughed at.' 'He is afraid of being left alone.'
claims.verification_ref: 被動動名詞＝being + 過去分詞（being laughed at）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: Sometimes the subject receives the action, so the infinitive is passive: 'to be + past participle'. We use it after verbs like need, have to, want, and seem: 'The room needs to be cleaned.' 'This form has to be filled in.'
teach.zh_hint: 有時主詞是「被動作用」的一方，所以不定詞要用被動：to be + 過去分詞。常接在 need、have to、want、seem 後面：The room needs to be cleaned.（房間需要被打掃。）This form has to be filled in.（這張表格必須被填好。）

teach.body: The letter still has to be sent. These dishes need to be washed before dinner.
teach.zh_hint: 這封信還得被寄出去。這些碗盤在晚餐前需要被洗好。to be + 過去分詞＝被動不定詞。

teach.body: After 'need' (and informally 'want'), an '-ing' word can also carry a passive meaning: 'The car needs washing' means the same as 'The car needs to be washed.'
teach.zh_hint: 在 need（口語也用 want）後面，用 -ing 也可以表示被動：The car needs washing. 跟 The car needs to be washed. 意思一樣（車子需要被洗）。

teach.body: To say that we arrange for someone else to do something, use 'have/get + something + past participle': 'I had my hair cut.' 'We are getting the house painted.'
teach.zh_hint: 要表達「我安排別人幫我做某事」，用 have/get + 某物 + 過去分詞：I had my hair cut.（我請人剪了頭髮。）We are getting the house painted.（我們請人在粉刷房子。）這叫使役被動。

teach.body: Nobody likes being laughed at. He is afraid of being left alone.
teach.zh_hint: 沒有人喜歡被嘲笑。他害怕被單獨留下。being + 過去分詞＝被動動名詞，當名詞用。

practice.stem: 選正確的被動不定詞：The room is dirty. It needs to ____ cleaned.（房間髒了，需要被打掃。）

distractor_rationales.being: 被動不定詞是 to be + 過去分詞，不是 to being；being 用在動名詞（being cleaned）而非這裡的 to ___ cleaned。
distractor_rationales.been: been 要配 have（have been），不能單獨接在 to 後面當被動不定詞。
distractor_rationales.to be: 句中已經有 to（needs to ___），再放 to be 會變成兩個 to，重複。

practice.feedback: 被動不定詞＝to be + 過去分詞：needs to be cleaned（需要被打掃）。

practice.stem: 選正確形式（使役被動）：My hair is too long. I'm going to have it ____ next week.（下週我要請人幫我剪頭髮。cut）

distractor_rationales.to cut: have + 受詞 + 過去分詞，不是 to cut；to cut 會變成「我自己去剪」而非「請人剪」。
distractor_rationales.cutting: cutting 是現在分詞／動名詞，使役被動要用過去分詞。
distractor_rationales.cuts: cuts 是現在式第三人稱，放在 have it ___ 的結構裡不對。

practice.feedback: have + 受詞 + 過去分詞＝請別人做：have it cut（請人剪）。cut 的過去分詞還是 cut。

practice.stem: 選正確的被動動名詞：Nobody likes ____ at in public.（沒有人喜歡在公開場合被嘲笑。laugh）

distractor_rationales.to laugh: to laugh 是主動、意思變成「喜歡去笑別人」，不是被嘲笑。
distractor_rationales.laughing: laughing 是主動的動名詞（自己在笑），不是被動。
distractor_rationales.been laughed: been 要配 have；被動動名詞是 being + 過去分詞。

practice.feedback: 被動動名詞＝being + 過去分詞：being laughed at（被嘲笑）。

practice.stem: 選正確的被動不定詞：This form has to ____ in black ink.（這張表格必須用黑筆填寫。fill in）

distractor_rationales.fill in: 表格是「被填」的一方，要用被動；fill in 是主動。
distractor_rationales.being filled in: has to 後面接原形被動不定詞 be filled in，不接 being。
distractor_rationales.been filled in: been 要配 have；這裡 has to 後面要原形 be。

practice.feedback: 被動不定詞＝be + 過去分詞：has to be filled in（必須被填好）。

practice.stem: 選正確形式（need + V-ing 的被動義）：Your bike is broken. It needs ____ .（你的腳踏車壞了，需要修理。repair）

distractor_rationales.repair: repair 是原形，不能直接接在 needs 後面當名詞。
distractor_rationales.repaired: needs 後面要用 -ing（repairing）或 to be repaired，不是單獨的過去分詞 repaired。
distractor_rationales.to repair: needs to repair 意思會變成「腳踏車需要去修理別的東西」（主動），不是「腳踏車需要被修」。

practice.feedback: need + V-ing 帶被動義：It needs repairing＝It needs to be repaired（需要被修理）。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 朗讀練習（不產音檔、不自動判讀）：出聲把句子讀一遍，注意 to be done、being done 這些被動片語連著唸順；一邊讀一邊想「誰被做了什麼」。

lines.text: The room needs to be cleaned before the guests arrive.
Nobody likes being laughed at, so we should be kind.
